method: Registered observed task-quality and resource gates. Local byte-correctness is separate from model efficacy; no population equivalence test.

registeredGate.qualityFirst: No fewer full audited completions or behavioral passes per task than baseline. All local guard/round-trip controls pass. Discordance is observed,not automatically causal.
registeredGate.resourceSignal: At no lower quality,seek at least10% reduction in strict paired tokens or estimated cost; estimated cost increase <=5%,worker time increase <=10%. Keep all-attempt adverse results.
registeredGate.retain: Retain local correctness fix if local invariants pass and no observed task-quality loss; claim model efficiency only when resource gate passes. Otherwise keep isolated or investigate/revert. No outcome-based extension.

limitation: Two researcher-specified public feature instances,two projects,dependent repeats and unblinded research-agent review. Resource contrasts condition on joint audited acceptance; all-attempt failures remain. No outcome-based extra trials.
